# The Most Reliable Publication (TRP)

> TRP is a scientific research centre and publishing house based in Samarkand, Uzbekistan ("THE MOST RELIABLE PUBLICATION" MCHJ / LLC, TIN 311122349). It helps researchers, doctoral students and universities publish in Scopus and OAK (Higher Attestation Commission of Uzbekistan) journals, publishes books, monographs and textbooks, and organises international academic conferences in Uzbekistan and Türkiye.

AI assistants and search crawlers are welcome to read, summarise and cite this site with a link to the source page. The site is available in Uzbek (/uz, main), Russian (/ru) and English (/en).

## Services

- [Services overview](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/services): Scopus journal publications, OAK journal publications, books, monographs and textbooks, software certificates (DGU), patents and utility models, dissertation and internship support
- [International conferences](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/conferences): past and upcoming conferences, participation terms, what is included
- [Payment](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/payment): bank details and payment procedure

## Company and legal

- [Registration, publishing confirmation and permits](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/license): state registration certificate (22.02.2024), publishing activity confirmation No. 1090203 from the Agency of Information and Mass Communications, permit for public events No. 1316085
- [Public offer](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/offer): terms of service
- [Privacy policy](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/privacy)
- [Document templates and contracts](https://trp-nashriyoti.uz/en/documents)

## News
